title: Star Wars — A farm boy and the Force

hook.quote: May the Force be with you.
hook.context: Jangdan oldin Han Solo Lukaga xayrlashib shunday deydi. "May ... be" — tilak bildiruvchi qadimiy shakl: "Kuch sen bilan bo'lsin". Bu gap filmdan chiqib, butun dunyoda ibora bo'lib ketgan.

reading: Luke Skywalker lives on a dry desert planet with his aunt and uncle. He works on their farm, but he dreams of flying spaceships and having adventures.

One day his uncle buys two robots, R2-D2 and C-3PO. Inside R2-D2 there is a secret message from Princess Leia. She must deliver the plans of the Death Star, a huge weapon that can destroy whole planets.
Luke meets an old man, Obi-Wan Kenobi, who tells him about the Force. The Force is an energy that connects all living things. A Jedi can feel it and use it, but he has to train for many years.
When soldiers of the Empire kill his aunt and uncle, Luke decides that he can't stay on the farm any more. He must leave home and help the princess.
They hire a pilot, Han Solo, and his huge friend Chewbacca. Han isn't interested in politics; he just has to pay his debts. Still, he agrees to take them, because they can pay him well.
In the end the rebels attack the Death Star. Their computers can't help Luke hit the target, so he switches them off and trusts the Force. He could easily fail, but he succeeds.
The story shows that you don't have to be a hero from the start. You can become one if you are brave enough to try.

grammar.title: Modallar: can / could, must / have to
explain: **can** — hozirgi qobiliyat yoki imkoniyat: A Jedi **can** feel the Force. Inkori: **can't**. O'tmishda — **could**: When he was a child, he **could** fly small ships.
**must** — so'zlovchining o'z ichki majburiyati yoki qat'iy qaror: "I **must** help the princess." **have to** — tashqi majburiyat, qoida: Han **has to** pay his debts (qarz beruvchi talab qiladi).
**mustn't** = taqiqlangan (qilmaslik SHART). **don't have to** = shart emas (xohlasang qil). You **mustn't** touch the weapon ≠ You **don't have to** be a hero.
Modal fe'ldan keyin fe'l doim asosiy shaklda, "to"siz: can fly, must go. Lekin **have to**da "to" bor va u zamonda o'zgaradi: has to, had to, will have to.

exercises.why: Modal fe'l -s olmaydi va to'g'ridan-to'g'ri fe'l bilan keladi.

exercises.q: Han ___ pay his debts, or he will be in trouble.
When Luke was young, he ___ fly very well.
You ___ be a hero from the start. You can learn.
exercises.why: Shart emas ma'nosi: don't have to.

exercises.q: Soldiers ___ enter this room. It is forbidden.
Luke decided: "I ___ leave the farm and help her."
exercises.why: O'z qarori, ichki majburiyat: must + fe'l.

exercises.q: Yesterday Luke ___ work on the farm all day.
exercises.why: must ning o'tmishi yo'q — had to ishlatiladi.

exercises.q: The computer ___ help him hit the target.

exercises.why: Savolda modal oldinga chiqadi: Can you...?

exercises.q: Tomorrow we ___ get up early for the mission.
exercises.why: Kelasi zamonda must emas: will have to.
